2835351f: Which house is Harry Potter in?
Harry Potter is in Gryffindor, like his parents. The Sorting Hat considered Slytherin before making up its mind.
00265533: What is the Disarming Charm in Harry Potter?
Expelliarmus is Harry's favorite spell, used to disarm an opponent. It is the spell with which he defeats Voldemort.
85a96ed6: What is the name of the Killing Curse in Harry Potter?
Avada Kedavra is one of the three Unforgivable Curses. It causes instant death without leaving a mark.
1fea4eae: Which animal guides Harry to the Sword of Gryffindor in the Forest of Dean in book 7?
A silver doe (Snape's Patronus) guides Harry to the Sword of Gryffindor in the forest in Deathly Hallows.
68620500: What is the name of the wizarding bank?
Gringotts is the bank run by goblins. Both the Lestrange vault and the Potters' vault are kept there.
bc4837ce: Who teaches Defense Against the Dark Arts in first year?
Quirinus Quirrell teaches Defense in first year. He shares his body with Voldemort, hidden beneath his turban.
6c9e0912: Dumbledore's full name is Albus Percival Wulfric Brian Dumbledore.
fe6d7161: What is the name of Harry's owl?
Hedwig is the snowy owl Hagrid gives Harry for his birthday on their first trip to Diagon Alley.
2bdcdf4f: Which spell makes light appear at the tip of a wand?
Lumos lights the tip of the wand. Its counterpart, Nox, puts it out. It is one of the most basic spells.
fcd7055a: Who is the Minister for Magic in books 1-4?
Cornelius Fudge is Minister for Magic for much of the series and refuses to admit that Voldemort has returned.
899b000b: What is the name of the Gryffindor ghost?
Nearly Headless Nick is the Gryffindor ghost: his head is held on by just a thin strip of skin.
b7678c39: What is the name of Hermione Granger's cat?
Crookshanks is Hermione's cat. Scabbers is Ron's rat, Hedwig Harry's owl and Mrs Norris Filch's cat.
e5971ece: What is the name of the great wizarding tournament in book 4?
The Triwizard Tournament pits a champion from Hogwarts, Beauxbatons and Durmstrang against each other, chosen by the Goblet of Fire.
dbd9f8f8: In the French translation of the books, what is Voldemort's birth name?
In French, Tom Marvolo Riddle becomes Tom Elvis Jedusor, the son of a Muggle and a witch, so that the anagram still works.
91bbde53: In the French translation, which phrase is an anagram of “Tom Elvis Jedusor”?
In French, Tom Elvis Jedusor is an anagram of “Je suis Voldemort”. In English, Tom Marvolo Riddle gives “I am Lord Voldemort”.
78eaf2a3: Which spell summons an object toward you?
Accio is the Summoning Charm, which calls an object toward you, whatever the distance.
a4049389: Alohomora is the spell that opens locks. Harry, Ron and Hermione first use it in first year.
80eabd19: The Death Eaters are Voldemort's loyal followers. They bear the Dark Mark.
e578a316: Who is the Durmstrang champion in the Triwizard Tournament?
Viktor Krum, Seeker for the Bulgarian national team, represents Durmstrang. Hermione goes with him to the Yule Ball.
07b1e722: An object in which part of a soul has been hidden
A Horcrux is an object in which someone has hidden a fragment of their soul to achieve a form of immortality.
09fea097: How many Horcruxes did Voldemort create?
Voldemort created 7 Horcruxes: the diary, the ring, the locket, the cup, the diadem, Nagini and, unintentionally, Harry.
f79b94e3: What is the incantation for producing a Patronus?
Expecto Patronum produces a Patronus, a guardian of light that drives away Dementors. Harry's is a stag.
eafd1572: What form does Hermione's Patronus take?
Hermione's Patronus takes the form of an otter.
d24aca98: What is the name of the magical sport played on broomsticks?
Quidditch is the magical sport played on broomsticks. Two teams play with Bludgers, a Quaffle and the Golden Snitch.
ec35b665: What is the Golden Snitch and what is its role in Quidditch?
A small golden ball worth 150 points that ends the match
The Golden Snitch is a small winged golden ball. The Seeker who catches it scores 150 points and ends the match.
63c13b49: Who teaches Harry Potions from first to fifth year?
Severus Snape teaches Potions until fifth year. In sixth year, Horace Slughorn takes over and Snape gets Defense Against the Dark Arts.
944c255f: What is the name of the Hogwarts caretaker?
Argus Filch is Hogwarts's grumpy caretaker, always accompanied by his cat, Mrs Norris. Hagrid is the gamekeeper.
c2b4df29: Which ritual does Voldemort use to return to a body in book 4?
Bone of the father, flesh of the servant, blood of the enemy
Voldemort is reborn in the graveyard through the ritual “Bone of the father, flesh of the servant, blood of the enemy”.
e5171bcf: What is the name of the wand shop in Diagon Alley?
Ollivanders is Garrick Ollivander's famous wand shop. “The wand chooses the wizard.”
0ceeeab3: What is the name of the wizarding prison?
Azkaban is the wizarding prison, guarded by Dementors who drain away happiness and happy memories.
de5421a2: According to the Tale of the Three Brothers, who was the first owner of the Elder Wand?
In the tale, Antioch Peverell, the eldest of the three brothers, receives the Elder Wand from Death.
0afea3bc: What are the three Deathly Hallows?
Elder Wand, Resurrection Stone, Cloak of Invisibility
The three Hallows are the Elder Wand (an unbeatable wand), the Resurrection Stone and the Cloak of Invisibility.
397a7766: What is the name of the werewolf teacher in Harry Potter?
Remus Lupin is a werewolf who teaches Defense in third year, one of the best teachers Harry ever had.
2a742b87: Reparo is the Mending Charm, which puts broken objects back together.
b84841da: What is the name of the magical map created by the Marauders?
The Marauder's Map shows every corridor of Hogwarts and where everyone is, in real time.
c5f1c55c: Who is the true master of the Elder Wand at the end of the series?
Harry is the true master of the Elder Wand because he disarmed Draco, who had won its allegiance from Dumbledore.
b6399f59: Who is really responsible for opening the Chamber of Secrets in book 2?
Tom Riddle, through his Horcrux diary, possesses Ginny and makes her open the Chamber of Secrets.
7fc678a6: What kind of animal is Crookshanks, Hermione's pet?
Crookshanks is Hermione's cat, an unusually intelligent animal who can recognize untrustworthy people.
c741ee6c: What is the name of the Slytherin ghost?
The Bloody Baron is the Slytherin ghost. He is covered in bloodstains whose origin no one knows.
35694593: What is Slytherin's distinguishing trait among the houses?
Slytherin values ambition, cunning and determination. Many Death Eaters came from it, but not all.
815edcf8: Which spell makes objects levitate in Harry Potter?
Wingardium Leviosa makes objects levitate. To fly, wizards use a broomstick.
d5c9f91a: The Grey Lady (Helena Ravenclaw) is the Ravenclaw ghost. She is Rowena Ravenclaw's daughter and stole the diadem.
6565bba2: Who became a Horcrux without Voldemort intending it?
Harry accidentally became a Horcrux when Voldemort's curse failed on him as a baby: a fragment of his soul lodged in Harry.
d810a2fc: What is the name of the headmaster of Durmstrang in book 4?
Igor Karkaroff is the headmaster of Durmstrang, a former Death Eater who gave up other names to avoid Azkaban.
103f8413: Who is the headmistress of Beauxbatons?
Olympe Maxime, a half-giant, is the headmistress of Beauxbatons. She comes with her students for the Tournament.
be183616: Which creature guards the vaults of Gringotts?
Dragons guard the deepest vaults of Gringotts. Harry and his friends escape on one in book 7.
f7253639: Which spell erases a person's memories?
Obliviate erases memories. Hermione uses it on her parents to protect them in book 7.
de15d816: Who is Voldemort's most fearsome female Death Eater?
Bellatrix Lestrange is the most fanatical Death Eater, torturing opponents with relish.
ebc0e4ff: Which magical servant creature can be freed by receiving clothing from its master in Harry Potter?
House-elves are magically bound to their masters and serve without pay. Dobby is the best known.
63a47a68: What is the name of Dumbledore's phoenix?
Fawkes is Dumbledore's phoenix. Its tears heal and it is reborn from its ashes.
247cdccd: What wood is Voldemort's wand made of?
Voldemort's wand is made of yew, with a feather from Fawkes, the twin of the one in Harry's wand.
4399c8ce: What do the Dementors symbolize in the series?
The Dementors symbolize depression, draining all happiness and forcing their victims to relive their worst memories.
74b30920: What is Harry Potter's wand made of?
Harry's wand is made of holly, with a feather from Fawkes, the phoenix who also gave the feather in Voldemort's wand.
7ef0a8d1: Which teacher does the Ministry impose in fifth year?
Dolores Umbridge is imposed by the Ministry as Defense teacher in fifth year. Her teaching methods are sadistic.
f91ecae0: What is the name of the secret group founded by Harry?
Dumbledore's Army (D.A.) is the secret group of students who learn real Defense Against the Dark Arts in fifth year.
5590086c: What is Harry's father's first name?
James Potter is Harry's father. One of the Marauders, he was an Animagus who could turn into a stag.
3ee68a75: Who says that “the wand chooses the wizard”?
Garrick Ollivander is known for saying “the wand chooses the wizard” during Harry's first visit to his shop.
17fb68f0: What is the name of the Divination teacher?
Sybill Trelawney teaches Divination at Hogwarts. Despite her theatrical manner, she has made two real prophecies.
0bc58b8a: How do you get into the Hogwarts kitchens?
By tickling the pear in the painting
Through a secret door in the dungeon
Tickling the pear in a painting of a fruit bowl opens the way to the Hogwarts kitchens, run by house-elves.
8cb5db11: Which spell makes the target laugh uncontrollably?
Rictusempra makes the target collapse with laughter. Harry uses it on Draco at the Dueling Club in book 2.
fef7fff1: What is the name of the dark magic shop in Knockturn Alley?
Borgin and Burkes sells dark objects. Draco goes there about repairing a Vanishing Cabinet in book 6.
75a83bfb: What is the name of the organization Hermione creates to defend house-elves' rights?
Hermione founds S.P.E.W. (Society for the Promotion of Elfish Welfare) in book 4. Her friends make fun of it, but she does not give up.
dbad4ef8: What is the name of the all-wizarding village near Hogwarts?
Hogsmeade is the only all-wizarding village in Britain. Students from third year up can visit it on certain weekends.
60eed161: What is the name of Hermione and Ron's daughter in the epilogue?
Rose Granger-Weasley is Hermione and Ron's daughter. She starts Hogwarts at the same time as Albus Severus Potter in the epilogue of book 7.
800a705e: What is the first name of Harry and Ginny's eldest son?
James Sirius Potter is Harry and Ginny's eldest son, named after his grandfather James and his godfather Sirius Black.
ebbdf782: What is the slur for a witch or wizard born to Muggle parents?
“Mudblood” is the insult used by pure-blood supremacists. Hermione is its main target despite her superior skill.
